children: According to Yonhap, JPX and the Hong Kong Economic Times, Asian index-futures firmed in the overnight session even as US Treasury yields extended their climb — the 10-year yield touched 5.293%, its highest since 2007, and the 30-year reached 5.621% — while the three main US stock gauges edged lower (Dow -0.26%, S&P 500 -0.17%, Nasdaq -0.09%). Chip names bucked the softness, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index up 1.32%, Micron up 1.1% and Meta up 3.2%.
Nikkei 225 index futures rallied in Osaka overnight. The near-month December 2026 contract settled its night session at 66,310, up 480 points, per JPX official data.
South Korea's KOSPI 200 night futures rose 0.95%, per a Yonhap market preview, pointing to a firmer open after the cash index fell 0.27% to 6,870.81 in the prior session.

Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index night futures ended the overnight session at 24,364, down 85 points. The NASDAQ Golden Dragon China Index eased 1.55% to 5,662. Among Hong Kong ADRs, Tencent's fell 0.99% to an HK$427.73 equivalent, Meituan's dropped 0.87% to HK$69.84 and HSBC's declined 0.59% to HK$158.06.

Taiwan's TAIEX futures advanced in the night session. The near-month October 2026 contract last traded at 48,479, up 698 points or 1.46%, after opening at 47,992 with a session range of 47,920 to 48,619.

title: ASIA NIGHT SESSION | Nikkei, TAIEX Futures Rebound Overnight on Chip Strength as US Yields Hit 2007 High
